name: create_cricket_publisher_schema
query: CREATE TYPE user_role AS ENUM ('user','admin'); CREATE TYPE fixture_status AS ENUM ('scheduled','live','completed','postponed','cancelled'); CREATE TYPE run_trigger AS ENUM ('scheduled','manual'); CREATE TYPE run_status AS ENUM ('running','success','partial','failed'); CREATE TABLE users (id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, "openId" varchar(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, name text, email varchar(320), "loginMethod" varchar(64), role user_role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), "lastSignedIn" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE TABLE tournaments (id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, name varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "normalizedName" varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE TABLE fixtures (id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, "externalId" varchar(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "tournamentId" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES tournaments(id), "teamOne" varchar(160) NOT NULL, "teamTwo" varchar(160) NOT NULL, venue varchar(255), "startTimeUtc" timestamptz NOT NULL, "localDateGmt6" varchar(10) NOT NULL, "localTimeGmt6" varchar(5) NOT NULL, status fixture_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled', "scoreSummary" text, "matchUrl" text, "bloggerPostId" varchar(128), "bloggerPostUrl" text, "firstPublishedAt" timestamptz, "lastPublishedAt" timestamptz, "lastSyncedAt" timestamptz, "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE TABLE publisher_settings (id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, "blogId" varchar(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "blogUrl" text NOT NULL, "scheduleCronTaskUid" varchar(65), "googleRefreshToken" text, "oauthState" varchar(128), "lastRunAt" timestamptz, "lastRunStatus" run_status, "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE TABLE publisher_runs (id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, trigger run_trigger NOT NULL, status run_status NOT NULL, "startedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), "finishedAt" timestamptz, "fixturesFetched" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "postsCreated" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "postsUpdated" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "apiStatusCode" integer, "bloggerStatusCode" integer, "postUrls" text, "errorMessage" text); ALTER TABLE users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE tournaments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE fixtures ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE publisher_settings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE publisher_runs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
